d: 4x2 Channel Dual Gang US, Dante/AES67 Wall Plate 2

specs.label: Input types
specs.value: 2 x XLR (balanced and RF filtered) 2 x RCA (stereo unbalanced) 1 x 3.5 mm (stereo unbalanced)

specs.label: Gain
specs.value: -18 dB, -3 dB, +25 dB and +40 dB, software selectable (Inputs 1/2)

specs.label: Maximum input levels
specs.value: +20 dBu @ -18 dB gain, +6 dBu @ - 3 dB gain, -23 dBu @ +25 dB gain -38 dBu @ +40 dB gain (Inputs 1/2) +12 dBu ( Inputs 3/4 A & B)

specs.label: Maximum output levels
specs.value: +12 dBu at 0 dB attenuation (output 1/2 A) +20 dBu at 0 dB attenuation (output 1/2 B)
